verse.name: v1a
verse.lines:
Death nor life nor angels nor powers
Present things nor things in the future
Height nor depth nor any created thing
Could separate me from Your love

verse.name: v1b
verse.lines:
Your love is written on my heart
There is not a flood that could quench this love
Your love is stronger than the grave
Death could never take me from this love

verse.name: v2
verse.lines:
I know the end of the story
I'll come up from the wilderness
Leaning on my Beloved

verse.name: v3
verse.lines:
Your love is so high
Your love is so wide
Your love is so deep
Your love is so long
